name: Citizenship by Descent (Jus Sanguinis)

qualifying_event.description: Being born to at least one BiH-citizen parent, either in Bosnia and Herzegovina or abroad. If born abroad, the child acquires BiH citizenship automatically if born on or before the applicable cutoff established in the Law on Citizenship of BiH, or must be registered with a BiH diplomatic/consular mission before age 23 in later cases; jus soli (birth on BiH territory to non-citizen parents) applies only where the child would otherwise be stateless.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Parent's BiH citizenship certificate and the applicant's birth certificate showing the parental link; for birth-abroad cases, proof of registration with a BiH mission before age 23.

requirements.blocker_text: The Law on Citizenship of Bosnia and Herzegovina grants citizenship by descent through either parent, gender-neutral, regardless of the child's place of birth. A child born abroad to a BiH-citizen parent acquires citizenship automatically in some cases, or must be registered with a BiH diplomatic/consular mission before turning 23 in others, depending on when the birth occurred relative to the law's post-1998 framework. Birth on BiH territory to non-citizen parents (jus soli) confers citizenship only where the child would otherwise be left stateless.
requirements.fix_path: Register the birth-abroad child with a BiH diplomatic/consular mission before age 23, providing proof of the parent's BiH citizenship.

evidence_required.document: Applicant's birth certificate showing parental link
Proof of registration with a BiH mission before age 23 (birth-abroad cases)

sources.title: Advokat Prnjavorac (Bosnian law firm/legal-text portal) -- Law on Citizenship of BiH, descent provisions, pre/post-1998 birth-abroad rules, age-23 registration cutoff, statelessness-prevention jus soli
